content: State->Timer is incremented with sample time for debouncing in- put signal. Once reached to the set period, old state is updated with X. State->Timer += dT; If (State->Timer  (TimePeriod * 10000)) State->XOld = X, and stop the timer, State->Timer = 0 where TimePeriod = Param->TimeLowHigh or Param->TimeHighLow
